name: Token 5
definition: Unencrypted sensitive data of a token.

PaymentToken.name: Payment Token
PaymentToken.definition: Contains the surrogate value of the PAN (such as token) or PAN.

TokenExpiryDate.name: Token Expiry Date
TokenExpiryDate.definition: Expiry date of the payment token or the PAN.

TokenRequestorIdentification.name: Token Requestor Identification
TokenRequestorIdentification.definition: Identification of a party requesting a token.

TokenAssuranceData.name: Token Assurance Data
TokenAssuranceData.definition: Supporting information for the Token Assurance Method.

TokenAssuranceMethod.name: Token Assurance Method
TokenAssuranceMethod.definition: Value that allows a Token Service Provider to indicate the identification and verification performed representing the binding of the payment token to the underlying PAN and cardholder.

TokenInitiatedIndicator.name: Token Initiated Indicator
TokenInitiatedIndicator.definition: Original transaction was initiated by Token.

StorageLocation.name: Storage Location
StorageLocation.definition: Storage location of the token. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

ProtectionMethod.name: Protection Method
ProtectionMethod.definition: Method used to protect the token. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

NonPayment.name: Non Payment
NonPayment.definition: True means the token is a non-payment token.

TokenRequestorName.name: Token Requestor Name
TokenRequestorName.definition: Contains the name of the token requestor

UpdatedChannel.name: Updated Channel
UpdatedChannel.definition: Indicate the channel used to update the token.

TokenActivationDateTime.name: Token Activation Date Time
TokenActivationDateTime.definition: The Date and time when token is activated.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
